newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Paccar plans to take over Dutch DAF Trucks.
newsitem.headline: Paccar plans to take over Dutch DAF Trucks.

text.p: U.S. truck-maker Paccar Inc has made a 933 million guilder bid to take over the Dutch company DAF Trucks NV, DAF said on Monday.
DAF Trucks is the successor company to DAF NV which was declared bankrupt in 1993. Its single biggest shareholder is the Dutch government with a stake of just under 40 percent.
DAF Trucks said the takeover offer by Paccar was supported by DAF's two main management organs, the executive board and the supervisory board. The offer will remain open until November 15.
